name: Corrado Manfredini
features: dark hair, tanned face, compact build, quiet manner
bio: Italian gentleman driver who bought a 512S from the factory for 1970 and shared it with Gianpiero Moretti under the Scuderia Picchio Rosso banner, then in Filipinetti colours at Le Mans. Made the most of the third-string Ferrari at every 1000 km race that season.
